The payment, submission and outcome are recorded facts. Their timing alone does not establish motive. A272 failed.

  1. 12 Aug 2024

    Handover terms published

    The preserved TLA launch post described administration moving after one month and configuration ownership after three. The exact wording is preserved in a later archive; its provenance is explained in the source record.

    Read the terms and provenance
  2. 27 Nov 2024

    The conservative counting cutoff

    Three calendar months after proposal 4817’s voting end. The launch text did not specify a starting-date formula. The strict operation count uses this common cutoff and excludes earlier actions.

    Inspect the counting assumptions
  3. 1 Oct 2025

    The fee-recipient role changes

    The registry fee collector changed from Stewardship to the ERIS fee account. The separately reconciled flow was 228 payments totaling 2,280 LUNA; its historical $159.95 value is outside the main subtotal pending overlap reconciliation.

    Follow the role change and fee flow
  4. 27 Jan 2026

    Creda analytics payment made

    A 10,000-USDC milestone payment followed A215. The later October capture of the dedicated analytics page is preserved so holders can compare the payment and the observed page state.

    Compare approval and captured output
  5. 30 Sep 2026

    0xphilipp votes on Estima’s release

    0xphilipp’s YES vote on A271 supported release of the 45,000-USDC kickoff payment. The original A266 grant had been approved by the other three directors.

    Inspect the grant and release decisions
  6. 3 Oct 2026

    Kickoff payment, then A272 submission

    The 45,000-USDC transfer occurred at 14:47:41 UTC. A272 was created at 15:02:16 UTC, 14 minutes 35 seconds later. The proposed removal and threshold reduction failed. Timing is recorded; motive is not established by timing alone.

    Read the sequence and transaction links
  7. 19 Oct 2026

    0xphilipp explains retained administration

    His public reply cited continuing operation and development, together with concerns about the board. The reviewed record did not identify an approval replacing the original handover deadlines.

    Read his explanation in context
  8. 23–24 Oct 2026

    Voting and control snapshots captured

    The voting audit covers A1–A289. Separate 24 October queries record technical roles and a passed Amplifier transfer proposal; execution was not shown at the captured heights. These snapshots are not live status.

    Inspect captured technical powers
